notes.title: Delisting the game
notes.content: [p]Hello dear users,[/p][p]Thank you so much for all the support, encouragement, and affection you've given this game over the years.[/p][p]Unfortunately, [i]Alice in Wonderland - 3D Game[/i] is now over 7 years old, and the video game market has changed significantly since its release. Our little first project on Steam now feels outdated and obsolete.[/p][p]The game itself is not free from bugs or flaws, but at the time, and through our youthful lens, we always saw that as part of its charm: poorly applied textures, clunky controls… It was a inexperienced team first project, wanting to take a shot and understand the world of PC games through a small experiment.[/p][p]But we are no longer that team. We’ve grown, improved, and most importantly, we’ve learned. And we feel this game no longer represents who we are as a studio. Since we are unable to update the game (we no longer have access to its source code) and don’t want to ruin the original experience with a remake that likely wouldn't carry the same charm, we've decided to remove the game from sale.[/p][p]Everyone who already owns it will still be able to enjoy it, but we don’t want to expose new players to the issues of a small, long-unupdated game that adds little value to today’s market.[/p][p]We hope you can forgive our selfishness, and thank you so much for all your support over the years![/p][p][/p][p]When? Well, we’re not really in a hurry, but it’s likely to happen before the end of August.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for all,[/p][p]Intelectiva Dev Team[/p]
